title: West Bay Marina

services.name: Kayak Storage
services.desc: The Puget Sound is a great place to go kayaking and Tugboat Annies has you covered for all of your kayak rental needs! We offer double and single kayaks, as well as life jackets in a variety of sizes. Once you are in the water you can explore the log booms outside of the marina, where harbor seals like to lounge in the sun, head over the Priest Point park or paddle all the way into downtown for an ice cream! 2nd shift: Breakfast first and kayaking starting at 11:00am, returning by 1:00pm. Kayaks must be returned by 11:00am for first shift, or 1:00pm for second shift. For second shift we recommend coming in for breakfast by 9:30am.
